conflicts: On-file catalyst stating TER 'fell ~13.3% in a broad semi-equipment selloff' on 2026-09-14 could not be independently confirmed in sandbox search; it has been omitted from the verified catalysts list above rather than re-asserted without a source.

PE and EPS figures conflict across snapshots of different vintages: equibles.com (~Aug 2026) shows trailing PE 55.5 and TTM diluted EPS $3.47; separate, explicitly older MarketBeat snapshots show trailing EPS $2.89 (trailing PE ~38, forward PE ~28, ~159M shares outstanding) and, in a different 2025 snapshot, trailing PE ~51 / forward PE ~38 with short interest 6.66% of float. These appear to be genuinely different time periods rather than a same-date disagreement, but could not be reconciled to a single current figure in this sandbox.

A German-language source (finanztrends.de) reporting Q3 2026 revenue of $737M and EPS of $0.89 with an 11%+ stock decline directly contradicts Teradyne's own Q3 2026 guidance ($1.2-1.3B revenue) and other sources, and appears to compare against Q3 2023 figures in error; disregarded as unreliable.
